set.body:
## Objective

Measure products per accepted step, directional/basis operations, pose factorizations, prior setup, cache size, rejection work and inverse/output cost across supported K and image sizes. Keep any local patch-motion approximation confined to qualified screening/preconditioning.

## Source and ownership

PRD: `docs/plans/flashalign-implementation-prd.md` (version 2, SHA-256 `a66500fec106a0df0f6635bb81329f44cca0a031cab32958c6c370f2ca6fc929`). Relevant sections/work packages: 10, 13, FA-11N. Original proposal and Python oracles are in `docs/plans/flashalign/` and `docs/plans/flashalign-prd.md`.

Planned paths (reserve exact paths at implementation time):
- `nonlinear JMH/operator probes`
- `memory and work receipts`

## Acceptance criteria

1. No image interpolation within Krylov products and no hidden K*K production normals; O(U*K) caches are visible/budgeted.
2. Report accuracy-versus-time/memory and preconditioner effectiveness, including nonlinear setup.
3. Rerun the exact linear performance court and prove no nonlinear initialization/allocation on linear fits.

## Blocking prerequisites

- N12: FA-N12: Implement information-supported model selection and nonlinear QC
- N13: FA-N13: Implement nonlinear records, inverse evidence and bounded output
- L22: FA-L22: Qualify linear phase costs and protect the fast path

## Evidence and completion

Record exact candidate/provider hashes, relevant commands and outcomes, fixture/config identities, numerical tolerances and all failure cases. Run the task-specific independent checks above and affected JVM/Scala.js/consumer gates; keep timing and scientific accuracy claims separate. Missing required input or a failing admission gate remains blocked, not silently passed. A completed experiment may report no benefit; dependent release/adoption milestones must still assess their own criteria.

## Integration constraints

Use canonical image4s/Ravel/Gale and existing reframe4s map/resample/registration ownership, typed failures and immutable plans with explicit workspaces. Preserve strict compiler policy, current motion/HalfFlow defaults, dirty-tree ownership and frozen experiments. Keep Flashalign linear execution free of nonlinear setup and direct HalfFlow dependencies. Shared primitives migrate through their current owner with both-consumer evidence; do not merge method objectives.
set.title: FA-N15: Profile nonlinear operators, preconditioning and extension overhead
